question: Test whether face-local readout can detect odd balance and determine minimal universal coverage.

objects.definition: squared aligned face record minus squared face carrier
objects.normalization: aligned face record scaled by odd rate

sources.source_status: integrated flag metric and sector rates

assumptions: Mean-zero carrier and copied primal flags in the closed Whitney model.
Common-phase preparation for individual face guards.
Shared atomic transition is assumed for candidate actuation.

technique_plan.technique: Face Gram and exact coverage controls

clock_receipt.update_rule: first directed populated face balance under common phase

dynamics_readout.state_space: mean-zero carrier and copied flag records
dynamics_readout.projection_and_kernel: two faces have a blind odd direction; any three span

target_exposure.selection_criterion: universal detection over nonzero odd preparations

calculation_steps: Prove three-face coverage and sharp bound

result.exact_expression: sum B_f=2B; any three faces see nonzero odd preparation; max face stock >= N/6
result.scope: Each face sum annihilates mean-zero even data. Three faces suffice for universal detection under common phase. Any two have a blind odd preparation. Full summed face balance recovers twice the odd stock balance.

counterexamples_and_failures: Any two fixed faces can miss nonzero odd stock
Common phase required for individual guard
limitations: Native face access, shared actuation and Stage 2 open
next_discriminant: Test physical access to face sums, shared commit and an off-range error bound.
